text:
maria (prod): thinking about how we express routing by plan + regional fallbacks. proposal attached below. want console UX + API shape before I formalize the rollout.

dinesh: show the proposal pls — critical for Dedicated customers who expect no silent fallbacks.

maria (prod): gist: free -> best-effort, can fallback to small quantized variants or CPU if needed; pro -> prefer regional cheaper variants with quota-aware soft-fallback; enterprise -> reserved capacity, no automatic downgrade unless manually allowed.

sam (platform): key questions: 1) how do we represent 'no automatic downgrade' in the policy? 2) quota enforcement: soft vs hard? 3) telemetry events that matter (fallback_count, throttle_count, fallback_reason).

ava (console): from UX POV we want a one-line summary per plan and a modal for advanced rules. simple toggle options: [Allow fallbacks], [Fallback priority: cost|latency|region], [Hard quota enforcement]. advanced shows JSON.

maria (prod): rough API shape I was thinking for internal config: ```
{
  "policy_version": "1",
  "plans": {
    "free": {
      "routing_weight": {"region-us": 0.6, "region-eu": 0.4},
      "fallbacks": ["gpt-small-quant", "gpt-cpu"],
      "quota_behavior": "soft_throttle"
    },
    "pro": {
      "routing_weight": {"region-us": 0.7, "region-eu": 0.3},
      "fallbacks": ["gpt-medium-quant"],
      "quota_behavior": "soft_fallback"
    },
    "enterprise": {
      "routing_weight": {"region-us": 1.0},
      "fallbacks": [],
      "quota_behavior": "reject"
    }
  },
  "global": {
    "max_concurrent_per_tenant": 200,
    "fallback_telemetry_enabled": true
  }
}
```

jason (sre): +1 to telemetry. we need counters and histograms for: `fallback.count`, `fallback.latency_delta_ms`, `quota.rejection.count`, and a per-tenant tag. also an audit log entry when a plan's `fallbacks` list is non-empty.

dinesh: i worry about semantics of `soft_fallback` vs `soft_throttle`. Soft_fallback = return cheaper model automatically; soft_throttle = queue and try to burst if capacity. We should name them distinctly and document exact SLA implications.

sam (platform): agree. propose canonical enum: `REJECT`, `HARD_THROTTLE`, `SOFT_THROTTLE`, `SOFT_FALLBACK`, `ALLOW`. and add `fallback_priority` field for tie-break: `cost|latency|region`.

ava (console): for the console, show summary as: "Free — soft fallback to quantized models; soft quotas (best-effort)." clicking "edit" opens advanced JSON. For enterprise, show a prominent banner: "Reserved capacity — automatic fallbacks disabled" with a confirm modal when toggling.

maria (prod): rollout plan: start with API and console flags in staging, then 10% canary for newly-created tenants (not existing), examine `fallback.count` and `customer_complaints` for 48h. if any unexpected rejections for enterprise, immediate rollback.

sam (platform): implement enforcement in the routing layer with a pre-routing policy check. if plan.quota_behavior == REJECT and tenant over quota -> return 429 with body: `{ "error": "quota_exceeded", "policy": "REJECT" }`.

jason (sre): add SLOs: fallback_rate_per_tenant < 0.5% for pro/enterprise. free can be higher. create alert when any enterprise tenant experiences fallback > 0.

dinesh: also need a migration story: older tenants without policies should default to `free`-like behavior but with a migration window and email notice.

maria (prod): audit + visibility: add per-plan row in Console -> Model Routing with columns: Allowed fallbacks, Quota behavior, Last fallback event, Fallback rate (7d), Canary status.

ava (console): will prototype the table. question: do we show raw policy JSON to admins? some want it for power users.

sam (platform): yes, but view-only by default; editable only via the internal policy API or when you have admin role. add `policy.etag` for optimistic updates so console and API modifications don't clobber each other.

maria (prod): security: enterprise toggle to allow fallbacks must require an explicit checkbox and audit log entry. also integrate with KMS for enterprise keys in Private deployments.

jason (sre): test plan: unit tests for enum handling, integration test with simulated high load to ensure soft_throttle vs soft_fallback behave as intended, and a chaos test that kills a regional pool to verify routing weights and fallback order work.

dinesh: one more: add metric `routing.variant_skipped` with tag `reason=fallback_disabled` so we can filter events where a higher-quality variant was intentionally blocked by policy.

maria (prod): ok action items: sam to spec API fields + etag, ava to sketch Console rows + modal copy, jason to write SLOs and alert rules, dinesh to draft migration email and docs. I'll draft RFC next week.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout job queued for 2026-06-08 02:00 UTC :rocket:

sam (platform): sgtm — i'll start the API PR today. will include example curl: ``curl -X POST /internal/policies -d @policy.json -H 'If-Match: <etag>'``

maria (prod): thanks everyone. if you have objections post here. otherwise i'll convert into RFC and send to eng-announce later tomorrow. :thumbsup:
